apache-polaris:managed-offering:current.notes: Self-hosted OSS project: managed options exist via Snowflake and others, but the project itself is self-run.

apache-polaris:oss-exit-path:current.notes: Apache-licensed ASF Top-Level Project; you own the deployment.

apache-polaris:serves-own-irc:current.notes: Native Iceberg REST Catalog, read and write, for any engine.

apache-polaris:rw-foreign-irc:current.notes: No bundled query engine, so the catalog cannot itself read or write foreign tables over IRC: foreign-table access needs separate compute.
caveats: The source rubric scores 'no engine' as 0 (BYO compute), so this is recorded as not supported rather than unknown

apache-polaris:federation-broker:current.notes: Real external-catalog federation that vends credentials to clients, but feature-flagged off by default and narrow: Iceberg REST (1.3), Hive/Hadoop (1.4) and BigQuery (1.5), with no Glue, Snowflake or Unity adapters and no generic-table federation.

apache-polaris:multi-engine-multi-cloud:.notes: Spark, Flink, Trino, Dremio, Doris, StarRocks and PyIceberg; storage-agnostic.
